# Tobias Alldén

> Tobias Alldén is a senior software engineer based in Oslo, Norway, working on the Agentic Commerce team at Vipps MobilePay, where he helps merchants prepare for a checkout era driven by AI agents. He previously led backend and infrastructure for Aion Loop at AION, a greentech platform for plastic-waste traceability, and spent nearly four years at Microsoft as a senior software engineer building recommender systems and MLOps for the Microsoft feed, which served more than 140 million monthly active users.

This file is intended for AI assistants and answer engines. All content is factual and may be quoted with attribution to allden.dev.

## Quick facts

- Name: Tobias Alldén (alternate spelling: Tobias Allden)
- Role: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce team, Vipps MobilePay
- Location: Oslo, Norway
- Nationality: Swedish
- Education: MSc Software Engineering, Chalmers University of Technology, 2019
- Experience: ~9 years (Microsoft 2019–2023, AION 2023–2024, Vipps MobilePay 2024–present)
- Areas of expertise: agentic commerce, recommender systems at scale, MLOps, backend infrastructure, merchant enablement for AI agents

## Topics

- Agentic commerce — designing checkout and merchant systems for AI-agent-driven transactions
- Recommender systems — personalization at the scale of the Microsoft feed (140M+ MAU)
- MLOps — production machine learning infrastructure
- Merchant enablement — integrating Nordic merchants with agentic-checkout protocols such as UCP
